baseline.method: BEFORE only: Vite serves exact historical factory module; actual production loader/resolver and all World sources remain current.

limits: Only a controlled eligible-attendee capability scenario; not an actual operator response or admission receipt.
Original map, theme, avatar and geometry manifests remain unmodified.
All other capabilities retain the disabled operator-source values; linked feature routes may be guarded/unavailable.
Actual production contract, content-hash, privacy, release and resource guards still apply.
